exposure: Pregnancy history (previous miscarriage, preterm delivery, stillbirth, cesarean section, gestational diabetes, small for gestational age)
cohort: 421,201 pregnant women in Norway between 2009 and 2013
finding: The risk of miscarriage was lowest in women aged 25-29 and increased with maternal age, showed a strong pattern of recurrence, and was also elevated after certain adverse pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: The risk of miscarriage was modestly increased if the previous birth ended in a cesarean section.
